title: The Cold Protocol
author: Xanthe Brightwater
blurb: Quentin Vasquez, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, has spent ten years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
